integrity: Proof and standalone finite reproducibility checks; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only vertex-disjoint deleted edges, both shore sizes at least three, and ordinary three-cut complexes. The integral sphere-wedge homotopy result is for the Alexander dual, not the original complex. The finite checker is mod two; the integral universal statement uses the proof. A prior equivalent unindexed formulation remains possible.
title: Partial-matching deletion in bipartite three-cut complexes: integral homotopy and two exceptional phases
